extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: three-wheeled auto rickshaw (tuk-tuk), approx. 2.8 x 1.5 x 1.95 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 0.54 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the handlebar 'tuk-tuk_handlebar' (with fork and front mudguard) is a separate object with its origin in the steering head (turn around local Z); 3 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll; the front wheel also steers); open sides, driver seat and rear bench; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
